session_control.protocol: Light16October+dark28October fit; light22October check, dark22October excluded from fit. Same fixed gates recomputed with training black.
session_control.scope: Exploratory postmeasurement control, not unseen confirmation; calendar sessions do not prove independent scene identity or temperature.

camera_sigma.scope: Illustrative unqualified plug-in sigma, not measured photo noise or new training input. Nonnegative signal estimate; independent sensor law, no RCD covariance propagation.
camera_sigma.interpolation: Positive log-log interpolation across existing ISO fits, no extrapolation. At12800 shot slope interpolated, dark variance directly observed; at4000 both interpolated.
